oracle_snapshots.name: Davros, Dalek Creator
oracle_snapshots.text:
Menace
At the beginning of your end step, create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace if an opponent lost 3 or more life this turn. Then each opponent who lost 3 or more life this turn faces a villainous choice — You draw a card, or that player discards a card.

strategy.primary: Make every opponent lose 3+ life on your turn (Maestros Charm, Boltwave, Court of Ambition, Loyal Subordinate, Torment of Hailfire), so Davros's end-step trigger makes a 3/3 menace Dalek and forces a draw-or-discard villainous choice on each of them; multiply the trigger with Auton Soldier, Strionic Resonator, Scientist Supreme and The Valeyard.
strategy.secondary: Punish the discard branch (Entropic Battlecruiser, Waste Not, Tinybones) and turn menace Daleks into a clock with Labyrinth Raptor and Dalek lords.

identity.why: Dalek and villainous choice every end step.
Instant 3 life from every opponent: turns Davros on for the full table.
Upkeep 3-life-or-discard for each opponent; both branches feed Davros.
